figure_description_zh: 妇女运动/政治外交/党内民主建设
figure_description_en: Women's Movement / Political Diplomacy / Party Internal Democracy

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 马克思主义妇女观/性别平等
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以妇女解放为核心，通过法律保障和组织建设推动女性社会地位提升。主张'妇女能顶半边天'，认为妇女是革命和建设的重要力量，必须通过法律和组织保障实现性别平等。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Center on women's liberation, promoting female social status through legal protection and organizational construction. Advocates 'women hold up half the sky', believing women are vital forces in revolution and construction, requiring legal and organizational guarantees for gender equality.
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Women hold up half the sky.
representative_cases_zh: 推动《婚姻法》颁布，废除封建婚姻制度
建立全国妇联及地方各级妇联组织网络
representative_cases_en: Promulgation of the Marriage Law abolishing feudal marriage system
Establishment of All-China Women's Federation and local branches

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以柔性智慧化解国际政治僵局，通过人文关怀、民间交流和制度对话而非强硬对抗来推进国家关系正常化。在中美、中日关系关键时期展现了中国特色外交智慧。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Resolve international political deadlocks through flexible wisdom, advancing normalization of state relations via humanitarian care, people-to-people exchange, and institutional dialogue rather than confrontational approaches.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 中美关系正常化/中日邦交正常化外交实践
process_zh: 识别外交僵局核心矛盾
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 外交以柔性化解僵局，以人文关怀推动理解
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Diplomacy resolves deadlocks through flexibility, promotes understanding through humanitarian care.
representative_cases_zh: 中美建交前外交破冰
中日邦交正常化过程中的民间交流推动
representative_cases_en: Diplomatic breakthrough before Sino-US normalization
People-to-people exchange during Sino-Japanese relations

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 倡导民主集中制制度化建设，通过批评与自我批评制度化和党内民主程序保障政党的长期执政能力和廉洁性。强调党内民主是政党生命力的源泉。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Advocate institutionalization of democratic centralism, ensuring long-term governance capacity and integrity through institutionalized criticism/self-criticism and intra-party democratic procedures.
process_zh: 制度化批评与自我批评
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Intra-party democracy is the life of the Party.
representative_cases_zh: 推动批评与自我批评制度化
党内民主集中制建设的长期实践
representative_cases_en: Promotion of institutionalized criticism and self-criticism
Long-term practice of democratic centralism

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 婚姻家庭法/妇女权益保障
thinking_modes.domain_en: Marriage and Family Law / Women's Rights Protection
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过推动关键性法律立法来从根本上改变社会结构和群体命运。以《婚姻法》为代表的法制建设实践，通过废除封建婚姻制度、确立男女平等和婚姻自由原则，从根本上改变了中国妇女的命运。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Fundamentally transform social structures and group destinies through key legislative initiatives. The Marriage Law practice, abolishing feudal marriage system and establishing gender equality and marital freedom principles.
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 废除封建婚姻制度，确立男女平等、婚姻自由
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Abolish feudal marriage system, establish gender equality and marital freedom.
representative_cases_zh: 1950年《婚姻法》颁布，废除包办婚姻、纳妾等封建制度
推动后续妇女权益保障相关立法
representative_cases_en: 1950 Marriage Law abolishing arranged marriage and concubinage
Subsequent legislation on women's rights protection

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过建立覆盖全国的三级组织网络（全国—地方—基层）实现群众运动的有效组织和持续动员。以妇联体系为例，建立了从中央到基层的完整组织保障架构。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Achieve effective organization and sustained mobilization of mass movements through a three-tier organizational network (national-local-grassroots). The Women's Federation system from central to grassroots.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 全国妇联及地方各级组织体系建设
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 建全国妇联、地方妇联、基层妇代会三级组织网络
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Establish a three-tier network of national, local Women's Federations and grassroots committees.
representative_cases_zh: 全国妇联体系建立
地方各级妇联组织建设
基层妇代会网络覆盖
representative_cases_en: All-China Women's Federation system establishment
Local branch construction
Grassroots committee network coverage

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将妇女权益保障纳入国家法制体系，通过系统性立法和配套措施确保女性在社会、经济、政治领域的平等权利。以《妇女权益保障法》为代表，构建了完整的法律保障体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Integrate women's rights protection into national legal system, ensuring female equality in social, economic and political spheres through systematic legislation.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《妇女权益保障法》相关立法实践
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 以法律保障妇女权益，实现真正的社会平等
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Protect women's rights through law to achieve true social equality.
representative_cases_zh: 推动《妇女权益保障法》相关立法
妇女就业、教育、健康等多领域法律保障
representative_cases_en: Promotion of Women's Rights Protection legislation
Multi-domain legal protection: employment, education, health

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过民间交流、文化互动和人文沟通来推进国家关系正常化，以非官方渠道打破政治隔绝。在中美建交前和改革开放初期发挥了重要的桥梁作用。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Advance state relations normalization through people-to-people exchange, cultural interaction and humanitarian communication via non-official channels to break political isolation.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 中美建交前民间交流/改革开放初期外交实践
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 以民间交流打破政治隔绝，积累互信推动官方关系
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Break political isolation through people-to-people exchange, accumulate trust to advance official relations.
representative_cases_zh: 中美建交前民间文化往来
中日邦交正常化中的民间交流推动
representative_cases_en: Sino-US cultural exchanges before normalization
People-to-people diplomacy during Sino-Japanese relations

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过廉洁、朴素、严以律己的家风建设，为党员干部树立道德标杆。周恩来邓颖超家风成为中国共产党的精神财富和道德典范，体现了革命者的政治品格和生活作风。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish moral benchmarks for Party members and officials through integrity, frugality and strict self-discipline. The Zhou-Enlai-Deng-Yingchao family tradition as the spiritual wealth and moral example of the CPC.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 周恩来邓颖超家风实践
representative_cases_zh: 周恩来邓颖超家风：廉洁、朴素、严以律己
为中国党员干部树立道德标杆
representative_cases_en: Zhou-Enlai-Deng-Yingchao family tradition: integrity, frugality and strict self-discipline
Moral benchmark for Party members and officials

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过渐进式、稳妥的方式推动社会制度改革，避免激进变革带来的社会动荡。在妇女解放和法制建设中采取'试点—推广'的渐进策略，确保改革成果的制度化和可持续性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Promote social system reform through gradual and stable approaches, avoiding social upheaval from radical changes. The 'pilot-then-scale' gradual strategy in women's liberation and legal construction.
representative_cases_zh: 《婚姻法》分地区逐步推广
妇联组织从城市到农村的渐进覆盖
representative_cases_en: Gradual regional promotion of Marriage Law
Women's Federation gradual coverage from cities to rural areas

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将妇女运动、政治外交和党内民主三个维度有机整合，形成多维一体的实践范式。以系统思维统筹各类社会变革实践，在复杂环境中寻找最佳解决方案。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Organically integrate women's movement, political diplomacy and party internal democracy into a multi-dimensional practice paradigm. System thinking to coordinate various social reform practices.
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 妇女运动、政治外交与党内民主三维实践的统一
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The unity of women's movement, political diplomacy and party internal democracy.
representative_cases_zh: 邓颖超三维实践体系：妇女运动/政治外交/党内民主
多维度统筹推动中国女性政治参与
representative_cases_en: Deng Yingchao's three-dimensional practice: women's movement / political diplomacy / party democracy
Multi-dimensional coordination promoting Chinese female political participation

data_sources: 中国人民政治协商会议官网资料
